note: Issue #45's test planet: an asteroid station a short hop from the port, with a size-1 town (a cantina with a stage, a guard at its door, a merchant in front, locals in the street) in metal (issue #75). Issue #99: a real ball (the asteroid type), the station sealed under a dome with a hallway to the port's landing pit, and flown to with no fade: 'at' is the centre of its ball in metres from the port, and its own port is on top of it. Its cantina owner is a new Oda, generated for this planet (no card: see src/systems/planets/planet_owner.gd). Two more domes off the landing pit, each down its own tunnel: the Remnant's barracks and the locals' homes ('domes'), and five Remnant outposts out on the rock ('landmarks'); the moon is taken like the port (content/core/story/territory.json 'moon'). Everything else comes from the planet generator. See docs/planets/PLANETS.md.

domes.note: The Remnant's metal barracks, at the end of a second tunnel out of the landing pit (town_kit.json 'domes'); taken like the port's barracks (territory.json 'moon').
The locals' homes: the station's gray homes, at the end of a third tunnel.

landmarks.note: The moon's five Remnant outposts (Territory's 'moon' front), 450 to 610 m out on the rock, each turned so its door (+x) faces the station. Out here there is no air: armour on.
